name: Neural Network RTE Simplification via Albedo Series
aliases: Albedo power series for neural prediction
Radiation Transfer Equation Simplification for Neural Network
definition: Simplification of the classical radiation transfer equation to express the co-scattering term F(p, ω) as an infinite series of albedo powers, enabling neural network prediction.
summary: Neural Network RTE Simplification via Albedo Series approximates multiple scattering by expanding the co-scattering term into an albedo power series, enabling efficient neural network prediction instead of iterative solvers.
